title: Hand off a command, a version and a report for finance

expected.says: Run's report for the tiny fleet matches the expected report

blueprint.signature: def finance_lines(fleet: list[Transformer], request: Request, plan: Plan) -> list[YearLine]
blueprint.contract: One YearLine per plan year, in order, years with no work included: year, units replaced, their replacement cost, the outages that year and their cost, the total (spend_by_year's figure), the budget, and the risk removed by that year's replacements (risk_removed, base curves). YearLine is a frozen dataclass of those fields, in that order.
blueprint.idea: A report's numbers come from the same functions the model and its tests use, so they add up to the plan.

lesson.title: 14.3.8 Handoff: Tests, Packaging and a Report for Finance

blueprint.signature: def finance_report(fleet: list[Transformer], request: Request, plan: Plan) -> str
blueprint.contract: The Markdown report the golden file shows: a title with the plan's years, the fleet's size marked as fictional data, the table of finance_lines with a Total row, and a closing sentence with the solver's status, the bound, and the plan's gap to it.
blueprint.idea: Report the bound and the gap, not the word optimal: they say how good the plan is.

lesson.title: 14.3.8 Handoff: Tests, Packaging and a Report for Finance

blueprint.signature: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int
blueprint.contract: Parses --units (default 500), --seed (2027), --budget, --gap and --out; scales the 500-unit request by units // 500 (at least 1), overrides its budget and gap when given, plans the generated fleet, and writes finance_report to --out or prints it. Returns 0 when a plan was found, 2 when not. The package's __init__ declares __version__, equal to pyproject's version.
blueprint.idea: A golden file pins the whole report; a change that moves the answer fails the test until a person reviews the new file.

cases: the finance lines add up to the plan's units, spend and value
the report for a 30-unit fleet matches the reviewed golden file
two runs write the same report
